verdict.rationale: The evidence shows cubic publishes REST APIs (Analytics and Members) with OpenAPI 3.1.0 specs, an interactive playground with code examples, a CLI and an MCP server. None of the evidence mentions official SDK client libraries. An OpenAPI spec and playground snippets are building blocks a developer could use to generate a client, not first-party SDKs, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
